summary: Iteration 5: Backend-only regression + new tests for Emergent object-storage-backed PDF file flow. Added TestObjectStorage class with 4 tests validating (a) upload persists to object storage with correct storage_path prefix 'anclora-tableextract/uploads/{user_id}/' and NO raw 'data' blob in the pdf_files reference doc, size matches uploaded bytes and /file returns identical bytes; (b) reprocess?mode=ocr loads the PDF from object storage and returns {ok, mode:'ocr'} with all tables extraction_method='ocr'; (c) cross-user isolation on /file returns 401/403/404; (d) DELETE removes the pdf_files reference and /file subsequently returns 404. Full suite run serially with pytest -n 0: 48/48 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/storage.py is minimal and correct (stale-key refresh once on 404 for both put/get). Consider caching storage_key with a TTL and adding retry with backoff on 5xx.
server.py falls back to legacy Mongo 'data' blob if put_object fails during upload — good graceful degradation, but log at ERROR/WARN level and expose a health check for object-storage availability.
No object-storage delete API is used (soft-delete pattern by removing the DB reference). Consider a background reaper/cron to purge orphaned objects once the storage API supports delete.
test_credentials: MongoDB test_database seeded sessions: 'test_session_fixed' (user_id=test-user-fixed) primary; 'other_session' (user_id=other-user) created on-the-fly for isolation tests.
seed_data_creation: Secondary user 'other-user' + session 'other_session' upserted via mongosh in TestHistory.test_user_isolation and TestObjectStorage.test_cross_user_cannot_read_file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has 48 tests. Object-storage backed flow is exercised end-to-end (upload -> /file -> reprocess?mode=ocr -> delete). Test 'test_upload_stores_reference_in_object_storage' uses mongosh --quiet to inspect the pdf_files reference doc; keep mongosh available. /tmp/sample_invoice.pdf (2081 bytes) and /tmp/multi.pdf must exist. Frontend was intentionally skipped.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. One initial test-scaffold assertion for the mongosh output (which does not quote keys) was fixed to compare against unquoted 'size' + size value.
